title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Pin-Up Blueprint Wall. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Pin-Up Blueprint Wall
options.lineage: architecture / ops plan review pin-up walls
options.thesis: The homepage is a review wall: tangled markups become one buildable sheet.
options.viewport: Full-bleed pin-up wall: fragmented workflow sheets left, BitBlabs wordmark as sheet title, Book CTA as approval stamp.
options.risk: Can read as architecture-agency if markups stay decorative instead of operational.

raised.raise: Cinematic Shared Clock — section transitions share one tempo so the wall 'redraws' in sync, not as random fades.
Overlapping Trace Lanes — translucent sheets slide and overlap during scroll, revealing stuck vs resolved states.
Definitional Margin — operational terms (handoff, stuck, system) live as pinned glossary chips on the wall edge.
Session Attract Preview — before Book, a short attract loop previews what the strategy session produces.

options.label: Ops War-Room Swimlanes
options.thesis: Stuck work is a live swimlane board: amber blockers clear into a continuous indigo flow.
options.viewport: Hero is one giant swimlane: people/inbox/sheet columns with stuck chips; Book clears the lane.
options.risk: Also the direction most AI-workflow consulting pages would choose if honest — familiar but strong for this ICP.

options.label: Signal Bench Scope
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope on a signal bench
options.thesis: Operational noise becomes a locked workflow waveform you can finally read.
options.viewport: Near-black scope face: noisy amber trace snaps into a clean green cycle; Book arms the trigger.
options.case: Wins product clarity for stuck→flow; loses audience ID with service-business owners who do not live on a lab bench.
options.risk: Reads as developer/hardware chrome if the phosphor stays literal.

options.label: Work Provenance Ribbon
options.thesis: Every stuck job is a custody ribbon: people, inboxes, gaps, then restitution into one system.
options.viewport: One continuous ribbon across the first viewport; broken segments = stuck handoffs; Book is restitution.
options.case: Holds product clarity for BitBlabs' handoff story; museum lineage is foreign until translated into ops custody.
options.risk: Feels curatorial or nonprofit if the ribbon stays silk-museum instead of operational.

options.label: Algorave Source Floor
options.case: Ops leaders do not identify with live-coding nightlife; product clarity collapses into spectacle.
options.kept: Shared cinematic clock — one tempo across the page.
options.risk: Nightlife energy fights calm operational trust.

options.label: Courtyard Color Canopy
options.case: Beautiful but fashion-courtyard identity, not service-ops identity.
options.kept: Overlapping translucent lanes as joint transition states.
options.risk: Reads as art installation over consulting.

options.label: Mondo Tech Spread
options.case: Loses audience trust and clarity for a calm $2k strategy offer.
options.kept: Definitional margin — terms pinned beside the argument.
options.risk: Retro novelty undercuts premium ops consulting.

options.label: Arcade Marquee Row
options.case: Entertainment aisle identity fights B2B booking seriousness.
options.kept: Attract-preview before commit — show the session payoff before Book.
options.risk: Playful cabinet energy misfires for owners spending $2,000.

canonCard.label: Category standard consulting landing
canonCard.thesis: Warm light SaaS consulting page: calm hero, indigo CTA, proof, FAQ — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Split hero with diagram, recognition grid, method, offer, proof, FAQ, final Book.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other AI consulting sites by design.
